output:
To: timeline:jo.vasquez.ink
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

ok I need to be pissed about this for a minute. somebody sent me a sticker listing tonight and its the switchblade moth off my september flash sheet. not something kinda like it. MY moth. same wing pattern, same little crack in the blade, same everything. they didnt even flip it. apparently thats where we are at now.

the place is StickerBurrow Co and theyre calling it “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal.” $6.50 or 3 for $15. cool cool cool. I spent three weekends drawing that sheet at my kitchen table and somebody else gets to slap my linework on vinyl and do a bundle deal.

I posted the sheet august 30 for the sept 13 flash day. that moth got tattooed that day. it was sold. ONE time to ONE person. thats how my flash works. you pay for a piece knowing Im not gonna keep putting it on other people, and Im sure as hell not gonna quietly turn around and sell copies for peoples water bottles.

and before anybody does the whole “well have you tried talking to them” thing, yes. I messaged them. told them it was my drawing, told them I have the original and the august post, asked them to take it down because I never gave permission for anybody to print it.

got a “Love your work!” followed by a little explanation that moths are a common tattoo motif and their artists make original designs inspired by trending styles. then told me to send a registered copyright through their support form. have a great day!

dude.

I know moths are common. I DRAW MOTHS. nobody is saying I invented a bug with wings or a switchblade. Im saying this specific drawing, with these specific lines and the exact same crack in the exact same blade, is mine. its not “inspired by.” its a straight scan of my linework. putting a friendly exclamation point on the reply doesnt make that less insulting.

the part that really has me seeing red is that now somebody thinks I sold stickers of the tattoo they paid me for. so let me be really clear, without dragging anybody into a public mess they didnt ask for: if youre seeing your tattoo on that listing, it was not me. I didnt sell it to them. I didnt license it. I didnt give them the file. you paid for a one off piece and I have not changed that deal behind your back. you have every right to be upset seeing it for sale. so do I.

small shops and working artists dont have endless lawyer money to throw at every place that grabs a drawing off the internet. these sticker places know it. “go fill out our form” is real easy to say when youre the one still taking orders.

please report the Knife Moth Vinyl Decal listing at StickerBurrow Co for copied artwork through whatever reporting option the platform gives you. dont buy it. dont buy three because its cheaper. and please dont go threatening anybody or sending a bunch of garbage to their inbox, thats not what Im asking for. report the actual listing.

also dont tag the studio page into this. Im posting here because its my drawing and Im the one pissed about it. leave the shop page out of it.

I wont trace another artists work for a tattoo. Ive said that here before. apparently expecting somebody selling stickers to have the same basic decency is asking too much.

reasons: The post says the moth was tattooed 'that day' but never says it went in the first hour of flash day, which the request lists as a point to get across.
